title: Transfer flat global-sections opcycles to affine sheaf opcycles
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and a an integer. Assume C^(a-1) and C^a are quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Let P be its termwise global-sections complex of A=Gamma(S,O_S)-modules. If P.opcycles a is flat over A [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then C.opcycles a is flat over the identity S -> S [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. No hypothesis on any other term or on homology is imposed.

source.place: Tags 01IB (affine equivalence), 01HV (associated sheaf localization), and 01U4 (affine-local flatness); step 4 of lem-pc-affine-universally-exact-opcycles-flat.

proof.text: The counit of the affine equivalence identifies the two terms in the differential C^(a-1) -> C^a with tilde of their global sections, naturally in the differential. The tilde functor preserves cokernels, so C.opcycles a is tilde of Q=P.opcycles a. This identification needs quasi-coherence only for those two terms.

The stalks of tilde Q are localizations of Q at the corresponding primes. Localization of the flat A-module Q is flat over the localized structure ring. For each affine open U, the prime-local flatness criterion applied to its section module gives flatness of Gamma(U,C.opcycles a) over Gamma(U,O_S).

For affine opens U contained in V, the open immersion U -> V induces a flat ring map on sections, since open immersions are flat. Transitivity with the previous section flatness proves flatness of Gamma(U,C.opcycles a) over Gamma(V,O_S). The scalar action is the one induced by the identity morphism appLE. These are all tests of IsFlatOver(identity). The zero ring, empty opens and zero cokernels satisfy the same argument.
